none: PAS FindID 939575: Roman Coin: Counterfeit Denarius of Antoninus Pius
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Silver or silver washed coin. Denarius, contemporary forgery, of Antoninus Pius (138-161) (RIC vol. 3 pages 64-65 suggests AD161 or shortly thereafter); chipped. Obverse description: Bust laureate right; tightly curled hair and beard. Obverse inscription; ANTONINVS PIVS AVG BAIT. Reverse description: Figure seated left holding patera with snake rising left, probably Salus. Reverse inscription:…
